sentences.zh: 他在佐治亚州圣诞老人镇这样的小镇出生长大，也去过像莱昂斯这样的小地方。

sentences.en: That picture on the corner, that's Dustin.

sentences.zh: 每当他在……的时候他就有点胖乎乎的

sentences.zh: 所以他们会觉得，看吧，就是傻乎乎的……

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah.

sentences.en: military back to the War of 1812.

sentences.en: I'm a girl from Philly, but I'm country as hell, so I got my cowboy boots on, and He meets a woman named Jenna.
sentences.zh: 我是个来自费城的女孩，但我骨子里透着乡土气息，所以穿着牛仔靴，然后他遇到了一个叫珍娜的女人。

sentences.zh: 当时播放的歌曲是《如果我告诉你》。

sentences.zh: 我在人群中远远看到了戴着帽子、穿着汗湿衬衫的他。

sentences.zh: 他说，嗯，想跳个舞吗？

sentences.en: I'm like, yes, I do.

sentences.zh: 于是我们跳起舞来，

sentences.en: The man that I got my name from?
sentences.zh: 我名字由来的那个男人呢？

sentences.en: I don't even know where he is now.

sentences.en: She's a schoolteacher in Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 她是费城的一名学校老师。

sentences.en: He's a soldier assigned to Fort Bragg, North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 他是被派往北卡罗来纳州布拉格堡的士兵。

sentences.en: But they're talking all the time.
sentences.zh: 但他们一直在聊天。

sentences.en: They're visiting each other.
sentences.zh: 他们互相探望对方。

sentences.en: He told his grandmother before he left that he had met the woman he wanted to marry.
sentences.zh: 他在离开前告诉奶奶，他遇到了想要娶为妻子的女人。

sentences.en: And then August happened.
sentences.zh: 然后到了八月。

sentences.zh: 在他们的恋爱过程中，他们知道他是一名特种部队士兵，另一次部署也越来越近了。

sentences.en: It was time for him to, you know, fulfill his duties.
sentences.zh: 是时候让他去履行职责了。

sentences.en: He told me he was doing paperwork.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我他只是在处理一些文书工作。

sentences.en: He didn't say much about what he was doing.
sentences.zh: 他没有多说自己在做什么。

sentences.en: They got a land deal, and I'm just there to do the paperwork, right?
sentences.zh: 他们有一笔土地交易，我只是去处理文书工作的，对吧？

sentences.en: He sent his family pictures of these beautiful landscapes, and he told them it was the military's version of a vacation.
sentences.zh: 他给家人发了这些美丽风景的照片，并告诉他们这是军队版的度假。

sentences.en: That's what he told me that day, sitting there on the couch, and he was, you know, leaving that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 那天他坐在沙发上就是这么对我说得，而且他那天下午就要出发了。

sentences.en: It's just paperwork.
sentences.zh: 这只是文书工作。

sentences.en: And then he leaves for Africa, a country called Niger, which is in West Africa.
sentences.zh: 然后他动身前往非洲，一个名叫尼日尔的国家，位于西非。

sentences.en: He said he was going to Niger to train the African Army skills to help them be successful and to bring their good into this world.
sentences.zh: 他说他去尼日尔是为了向非洲军队传授技能，帮助他们取得成功，并把善良带给这个世界。

sentences.en: He said, I'm a teacher just like you.
sentences.zh: 他说，我和你一样是一名老师。

sentences.en: I'm there to teach them ways so they can be successful.
sentences.zh: 我去那里是为了教他们方法，好让他们走向成功。

sentences.en: Did you know how much danger he was in?
sentences.zh: 你知道他当时处境有多危险吗？

sentences.en: We didn't think he was in any danger at all.
sentences.zh: 我们根本觉得他一点危险也没有。

sentences.en: And, you know, you're talking to people who didn't even know how to pronounce Niger.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，你面对的是那些甚至不知道怎么发“尼日尔”这个词音的人。

sentences.en: You know, we had to look it up on the map to see exactly where it all happened.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们不得不去地图上查一下，看看这一切到底发生在哪里。

sentences.en: They know he wasn't deployed to one of the combat zones they've seen on TV, somewhere like Iraq or Afghanistan,

sentences.zh: 而且人们对他的工作所涉及的风险并不是很清楚。

sentences.zh: 对我们来说这是平常的一天。

sentences.en: I got to school.
sentences.zh: 我到了学校。

sentences.en: Lunchtime, he texted me.

sentences.en: And at 3.30, October 3rd,
sentences.zh: 在10月3日下午3点30分，

sentences.en: he told me that they were a change of plans and they were going to not return to that base that night.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我计划有变，他们今晚不回那个基地了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Told him I loved him.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他我爱他。

sentences.en: Love you too, darling.
sentences.zh: 我也爱你，亲爱的。

sentences.en: I'll talk to you as soon as I get back to base.
sentences.zh: 我一回基地就跟你联系。

sentences.en: He said, I'm losing reception soon.

sentences.en: I'll try to call you later if I can.

sentences.en: But I'm part of the job.
sentences.zh: 但这就是工作的一部分。

sentences.en: I'm like, you can do it, my man.
sentences.zh: 我说，你能做到的，伙计。

sentences.en: So, it was about midnight when two soldiers arrived at Dustin's grandmother's house.
sentences.zh: 大约午夜时分，两名士兵来到了达斯汀奶奶的家。

sentences.en: And he opened the door and I, this leg,
sentences.zh: 他打开门，我，这条腿，

sentences.en: I could see his leg.
sentences.zh: 我能看到他的腿。

sentences.en: And I sort of looked up and his uniform came into play and he began to tell, say these words to me.
sentences.zh: 我抬头看了一眼，他的制服映入眼帘，然后他开始对我吐露这些话。

sentences.en: He was so sorry.
sentences.zh: 他感到非常抱歉。

sentences.en: My grandson had been killed that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我的孙子那天下午阵亡了。

sentences.en: And I said, no, no.
sentences.zh: 我说，不，不。

sentences.en: No, no, God, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，上帝啊，不。

sentences.en: How could, how could Dustin, how could this happen to Dustin?
sentences.zh: 怎么会，达斯汀怎么会，这怎么会发生在上达斯汀身上？

sentences.en: How could Dustin be killed?
sentences.zh: 达斯汀怎么可能会牺牲？

sentences.en: How could this be?

sentences.en: The town is shocked when Dustin Wright is killed.
sentences.zh: 达斯汀·赖特遇害后，整个小镇都震惊了。

sentences.en: And when his body was brought back from Africa, people lined the streets of this small town.
sentences.zh: 当他的遗体从非洲运回来时，镇上的人们排满了街道。

sentences.en: They had to have his funeral
sentences.zh: 他们不得不在高中美式足球场

sentences.en: at the high school football stadium because it was the only place where they could fit the crowd that wanted to come.
sentences.zh: 举办他的葬礼，因为那是唯一能容纳蜂拥而至的人群的地方。

sentences.en: That's when members of his family started to wonder.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他的家人开始产生疑惑。

sentences.en: What was going on in Africa?
sentences.zh: 非洲那边到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: He didn't make it out to be anything.
sentences.zh: 他从来没把这当回事。

sentences.en: They had a land deal going on.
sentences.zh: 他们当时正在谈一笔土地交易。

sentences.en: He was over there assisting.
sentences.zh: 他是在那边协助。

sentences.en: That was it.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样。

sentences.en: That was it.
sentences.zh: 仅此而已。

sentences.en: I'm telling you, Dustin didn't brag.
sentences.zh: 我跟你说，达斯汀从不吹牛。

sentences.en: He didn't say more than he needed to say.
sentences.zh: 他言简意赅，不多说废话。

sentences.en: And it wasn't that he was intentionally keeping things from us, but it was not his place to tell.
sentences.zh: 并不是他故意对我们隐瞒什么，而是有些事不该由他来说。

sentences.en: So he didn't.

sentences.en: And I guess that's why it comes as such a shock.
sentences.zh: 我想这也是为什么这消息会如此令人震惊。

sentences.en: Some members of his family still want a simple explanation of why American forces need to be in Niger in the first place.
sentences.zh: 他的部分家人仍然想要一个简单的解释：为什么美军一开始就要去尼日尔？

sentences.en: I'll have a list of questions when they get here.
sentences.zh: 等他们到了，我有一连串的问题要问。

sentences.en: Are we protecting the United States by being over there?
sentences.zh: 我们在那边是为了保护美国吗？

sentences.en: Why are we even over there?
sentences.zh: 我们究竟为什么要去那儿？

sentences.en: What is he doing in Africa?
sentences.zh: 他在非洲到底在干什么？

sentences.en: Because you don't think of your military in Africa.
sentences.zh: 因为你根本不会联想到你的军队会在非洲。

sentences.en: What was he doing?
sentences.zh: 他当时在做什么？

sentences.en: Just what he did protect us.
sentences.zh: 正如他所做的那样，保护我们。

sentences.en: Where was he?
sentences.zh: 他在哪里？

sentences.en: Because I got serious questions.
sentences.zh: 因为我有严肃的问题要问。

sentences.en: Who was he fighting?
sentences.zh: 他在跟谁战斗？

sentences.en: Why was he fighting?
sentences.zh: 他为什么要战斗？

sentences.en: When we come back, what happened in Niger?
sentences.zh: 节目稍后回来，尼日尔究竟发生了什么？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 Dealbook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th,
I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 我将在纽约市的 Dealbook 峰会上，与商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领袖进行现场对话，其中包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.en: Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在 11 月 18 日于 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你绝对不想错过。

sentences.en: I'm walking inside a military prison
sentences.zh: 我正走进一座位于

sentences.en: in northwestern Niger.
sentences.zh: 尼日尔西北部的军事监狱。

sentences.en: There's a woman who is beating, I think, millet in a bowl.
sentences.zh: 有个女人正在碗里舂着小米，我想是的。

sentences.en: That's the sound that you're about to hear.
sentences.zh: 接下来你听到的就是这个声音。

sentences.en: Thank you, madam.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，女士。

sentences.en: Rukmini Kalamaki covers ISIS for the Times.
sentences.zh: 鲁克米尼·卡拉马基负责《纽约时报》的 ISIS 报道。

sentences.en: A couple of days ago, I got back from Niger, where I went to ask the question, what happened to these four American soldiers who were killed in an ambush
sentences.zh: 几天前，我从尼日尔返回。我去那里是为了追问一个问题：这四名美国士兵怎么会在非洲一个被人遗忘的偏远角落的一场伏击中丧生？

sentences.en: in a forgotten and remote corner of Africa in a war that I think very few people understand?
sentences.zh: 在这场我认为极少有人真正理解的战争中？

sentences.en: What the Pentagon has told the American people about what has happened has shifted numerous times.
sentences.zh: 五角大楼向美国人民讲述的事发经过已经改了好几次。

sentences.en: They began by saying one version of events that then changed, it changed again.
sentences.zh: 他们先是说了一种版本的事件经过，接着又改了，然后又改了一次。

sentences.en: So I wanted to get on the ground and I wanted to speak to the people who had actually witnessed it.
sentences.zh: 所以我想要亲赴实地，去找那些真正亲眼目睹过的人谈谈。

sentences.en: Direct eyewitnesses to what happened.
sentences.zh: 事件的直接目击者。

sentences.en: Do you think that he's willing to speak to me?
sentences.zh: 你觉得他愿意跟我谈谈吗？

sentences.en: The most difficult thing was to try to speak to actual members of the terror group that carried it out.
sentences.zh: 最困难的事情，是试图联系到实施这起袭击的恐怖组织真正的成员。

sentences.en: So you think that this guy Hassan, if I get permission to speak to him, he's going to help?
sentences.zh: 所以你认为这个叫哈桑的家伙，如果我得到许可去和他交谈，他会帮忙吗？

sentences.en: Yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 会，会的。

sentences.en: He knows a lot about the group?
sentences.zh: 他对这个组织很了解吗？

sentences.en: He knows everything.
sentences.zh: 他什么都知道。

sentences.en: Everything.
sentences.zh: 无所不知。

sentences.en: And I was able to speak to two in a prison in Kolo, Niger.
sentences.zh: 我得以在尼日尔科洛的一座监狱里采访了两个人。

sentences.en: He's a well-known terrorist in the area.
sentences.zh: 他是当地一个知名的恐怖分子。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And what did you find in Niger?
sentences.zh: 你在尼日尔发现了什么？

sentences.en: Can you start me at the morning of the ambush?
sentences.zh: 能从伏击发生的那个早晨开始讲起吗？

sentences.en: So the morning of the ambush is October 4th.
sentences.zh: 伏击发生的早晨是 10 月 4 日。

sentences.en: I'm actually going to start one day earlier,
sentences.zh: 其实我要从前一天开始讲起，

sentences.en: October 3rd.
And it was at around 6 a.m.
sentences.zh: 大约在 10 月 3 日早上 6 点，

sentences.en: on October 3rd that a mixed patrol of American and Nigerian troops left the gates of their base
sentences.zh: 一支由美军和尼日尔军队组成的混合巡逻队驶出了基地大门。

sentences.en: The Americans included Green Berets as well as other troops.
sentences.zh: 美军人员包括绿色贝雷帽以及其他部队。

sentences.en: And they set off on what they had planned to be a low-risk routine patrol, a classic hearts and minds exercise.
sentences.zh: 他们出发执行一项他们计划中低风险的常规巡逻，这是一次经典的“争取民心”行动。

sentences.en: And what does a routine patrol look like?
sentences.zh: 常规巡逻是什么样的？

sentences.en: What the Nigerian troops told me who were accompanying the Americans is they were told it's an aller-retour.
sentences.zh: 陪同美军的尼日尔士兵告诉我，他们接到通知这是一次“来回折返”任务。

sentences.en: In French, that means go out and come back.
sentences.zh: 在法语里，这意味着出去然后回来。

sentences.en: So they set off at 6 o'clock in the morning.
sentences.zh: 于是他们在早上 6 点出发。

sentences.en: They spend all day.
sentences.zh: 他们花了一整天时间。

sentences.en: They stop in villages.
sentences.zh: 他们在村庄停歇。

sentences.en: They meet with local community leaders.
sentences.zh: 他们会见当地社区领袖。

sentences.en: In the late afternoon, they begin heading home.
sentences.zh: 在下午晚些时候，他们开始启程回营。

sentences.en: And they're basically a couple dozen miles away from the gates of their compound when the convoy stops.
sentences.zh: 当车队停下时，他们基本上离营地大门只有几十英里远。

sentences.en: And they're told that their mission has changed.
sentences.zh: 然后他们被告知任务变了。

sentences.en: And what is the new mission?
sentences.zh: 那新任务是什么？

sentences.en: The order that they've gotten is that American intelligence agencies have honed in on a signal from an electronic device belonging to a suspected terrorist named Dundun Shefu.
sentences.zh: 他们收到的命令是，美国情报机构锁定了一个电子设备的信号，该设备属于一名名叫敦敦·谢富的疑似恐怖分子。

sentences.en: They've identified what they think is his camp where he's hiding out in the far north of the terrain where they're searching.
sentences.zh: 他们锁定了他们认为是他藏身营地的位置，位于他们搜寻区域的最北端。

sentences.en: And they want them to go and back up another American special forces counterterrorism raid as they go in to raid that camp.
sentences.zh: 他们希望美军去增援另一支美国特种部队的反恐突袭行动，协助突袭那个营地。

sentences.en: And this is where things start to fall apart.
sentences.zh: 事情就是从这里开始急转直下的。

sentences.en: They go into the camp and they find nobody, but they do find traces of the terror group.
sentences.zh: 他们进入营地后没有发现任何人，但确实找到了恐怖组织的痕迹。

sentences.en: They find ammunition.
sentences.zh: 他们找到了弹药。

sentences.en: They find the tire tracks of motorcycles that had sped off.
sentences.zh: 他们找到了加速逃离的摩托车轮胎印。

sentences.en: So they had somehow been alerted and had left the campsite before the Americans got there.
sentences.zh: 所以他们不知通过什么途径收到了风声，在美军到达之前就离开了营地。

sentences.en: Now, the irony in all of this is that was supposed to be the high-risk thing, the raid on this campsite.
sentences.zh: 这里面极具讽刺意味的是，突袭这个营地本该是高风险任务。

sentences.en: And they got there and they were fine.
sentences.zh: 但他们到达那里时一切正常。

sentences.en: Nothing happened.
sentences.zh: 什么都没发生。

sentences.en: They spent some time there.
sentences.zh: 他们在那里呆了一会儿。

sentences.en: And as the sun was rising, they were heading home.
sentences.zh: 当太阳升起时，他们正准备启程回营。

sentences.en: And that's the real tragedy here because what happens next happens on an unplanned stop in a village they were not supposed to stop in.
sentences.zh: 而真正的悲剧就在这里发生了——接下来的事发生在一个本不该停留的村庄的一次计划外停留中。

sentences.en: But they've been out now for more than 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 但他们此时已经在外面待了超过 24 小时。

sentences.en: In the desert?
sentences.zh: 在沙漠里？

sentences.en: In the desert.
sentences.zh: 在沙漠里。

sentences.en: They're out of water.
sentences.zh: 他们的水喝光了。

sentences.en: The first village on their way back is a place called Tongotongo.
sentences.zh: 他们回程途中的第一个村庄是一个叫通戈通戈的地方。

sentences.en: And they stop at a well to fill up their water bottles.
sentences.zh: 他们在水井旁停下，给水壶灌水。

sentences.en: At this point, the village chief has learned that they are there and he walks out to meet them.
sentences.zh: 此时，村长得知他们到了，便步行出来迎接。

sentences.en: He tells them that there are several sick children in the village and could they help them.
sentences.zh: 他告诉他们村里有几个生病的孩子，问他们能不能帮帮忙。

sentences.en: So as part of their Hearts and Minds campaign, they do carry supplies that are specifically meant to be distributed to villagers.
sentences.zh: 因此，作为“争取民心”行动的一部分，他们确实携带了专门用于分发给村民的物资。

sentences.en: So they take out the medicine that they have and they start distributing it to the people there.
sentences.zh: 于是他们拿出随身携带的药品，开始分发给那里的居民。

sentences.en: But something's not quite right.
sentences.zh: 但有些事情不太对劲。

sentences.en: It's at this point in time that several members of the unit tell us that they start noticing that the looks on the faces of villagers are not welcoming, even menacing.
sentences.zh: 正是在这个时候，部队的几名成员告诉我们，他们开始注意到村民脸上的表情极不友好，甚至带着威胁性。

sentences.en: They notice groups of young men gathering.
sentences.zh: 他们注意到成群的年轻人在聚集。

sentences.en: They notice several people on motorcycles who speed off as if they're going to pass a message to somebody.
sentences.zh: 他们注意到几个人骑着摩托车飞驰而去，就像去向某人通风报信一样。

sentences.en: And most of all, they notice that the village chief keeps on trying to delay them.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，他们注意到村长一直在试图拖延时间。

sentences.en: Every time they get ready to leave, he seems to have some other question or some other reason for them to stay.
sentences.zh: 每当他们准备离开时，他似乎总有别的问题或别的借口让他们留下来。

sentences.en: They finally decide to leave.
sentences.zh: 他们最终决定离开。

sentences.en: They get on to the backs of their trucks and not even 200 yards past the village, they begin taking heavy and deadly fire.
sentences.zh: 他们爬上卡车后厢，离开村子还不到 200 码，就遭到猛烈而致命的火力袭击。

sentences.en: This is the ambush.
sentences.zh: 这就是伏击。

sentences.en: This is the ambush.
sentences.zh: 这就是伏击。

sentences.en: The Pentagon told us repeatedly that they did not leave these soldiers behind.
sentences.zh: 五角大楼多次告诉我们，他们并没有抛弃这些士兵。

sentences.en: The New York Times acquired the body camera footage of one of the four dead Americans and that footage tells a very different story.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》获取了四名牺牲美军中一人的随身摄像机画面，而这段画面讲述了一个完全不同的故事。

sentences.en: In the footage, you see three of the four Americans who die on this day.
sentences.zh: 在画面中，你可以看到当天阵亡的四名美军中的三人。

sentences.en: And what you see is that they are outgunned and overrun by this terrorist group and that nobody comes to their aid.
sentences.zh: 你看到的是，他们在火力上被这个恐怖组织压制并击溃，而且没有人来支援他们。

sentences.en: You specifically see a black SUV, which is where Staff Sergeant Brian Black,
sentences.zh: 你特别能看到一辆黑色 SUV，上士布莱恩·布莱克、

sentences.en: Staff Sergeant Jeremiah Johnson, and Staff Sergeant Dustin Wright find themselves.
sentences.zh: 上士耶利米·约翰逊和上士达斯汀·赖特就在那里。

sentences.en: One of them is at the wheel.
sentences.zh: 其中一人在驾驶座上。

sentences.en: Two of them have emerged from the car and they're trying to use the chasey of the car for cover.
sentences.zh: 另外两人从车里钻出来，试图利用车身底盘作掩护。

sentences.en: They're shooting over the hood.
sentences.zh: 他们在引擎盖上方射击。

sentences.en: They're trying to hide behind the wheel well.
sentences.zh: 他们试图躲在轮拱后面。

sentences.en: Brian Black is the first to go down.
sentences.zh: 布莱恩·布莱克第一个倒下。

sentences.en: His colleagues rush to help him.
sentences.zh: 他的战友冲过去营救他。

sentences.en: They pull him back by the strap of his flak jacket and try to bring him back behind the wheel of the car.
sentences.zh: 他们抓住他防弹衣上的提手把他拉回来，试图把他拉到车轮后方。

sentences.en: They're then taking positions, trying to keep firing at the enemy, but the enemy is right upon them.
sentences.zh: 他们随后占据掩体，试图继续向敌人开火，但敌人已经逼近他们眼前。

sentences.en: And the surviving two just start running.
sentences.zh: 幸存的两名士兵开始逃跑。

sentences.en: And they're running and running.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在跑。

sentences.en: You're seeing it through the viewfinder of the soldier who's behind the firSt.
sentences.zh: 你是通过殿后士兵的取景器看到这一切的。

sentences.en: They're running past shrubs.
sentences.zh: 他们跑过灌木丛。

sentences.en: They're running past trees.
sentences.zh: 他们跑过树木。

sentences.en: They're running past little huts.
sentences.zh: 他们跑过小茅屋。

sentences.en: The next soldier, Jeremiah Johnson, is hit.
sentences.zh: 下一名士兵耶利米·约翰逊中弹了。

sentences.en: And you see him fall and roll.
sentences.zh: 你看到他倒下并翻滚。

sentences.en: You see his colleague, Staff Sergeant Dustin Wright, stop running and take a position next to basically a desert shrub and try to hold off the attackers.
sentences.zh: 你看到他的战友、上士达斯汀·赖特停下脚步，在一处沙漠灌木丛旁就地寻找掩护，试图抵挡袭击者。

sentences.en: One U.S.
sentences.zh: 一名美国

sentences.en: soldier with virtually no protection.
sentences.zh: 士兵几乎没有任何保护。

sentences.en: With no protection.
sentences.zh: 没有任何保护。

sentences.en: And he's behind this bush that is so wispy that you literally see the branches ricocheting from the force of his weapon.
sentences.zh: 他躲在这丛如此稀疏的灌木后面，以至于你几乎能看到树枝因他武器的后坐力而不断反弹。

sentences.en: And he holds them off for at least a minute and a half, possibly longer.
sentences.zh: 他阻击了敌人至少一分半钟，可能更久。

sentences.en: But he's just one person.
sentences.zh: 但他毕竟只有一个人。

sentences.en: And they descend on the soldier who was down.
sentences.zh: 敌人向倒地的士兵蜂拥而上。

sentences.en: They open fire on him.
sentences.zh: 他们向他开火。

sentences.en: And then they turn their fire on Sergeant Wright.
sentences.zh: 然后他们将火力对准了赖特中士。

sentences.en: Okay, so now we know
sentences.zh: 好的，所以现在我们知道了

sentences.en: what happened to Sergeant Wright and these three other soldiers.
sentences.zh: 赖特中士和这另外三名士兵发生了什么事。

sentences.en: But I think a lot of people, including Sergeant Wright's family, don't really understand what these soldiers were doing in Africa.
sentences.zh: 但我认为很多人，包括赖特中士的家人，并不真正理解这些士兵在非洲到底在做什么。

sentences.en: What were they doing there?
sentences.zh: 他们在那儿做什么？

sentences.en: Niger is now one of the battlefronts in the war on terror.
sentences.zh: 尼日尔现在是反恐战争的前线之一。

sentences.en: Very much so in the war on the Islamic State.
sentences.zh: 在打击伊斯兰国的战争中尤其如此。

sentences.en: Africa is where I actually started investigating terror.
sentences.zh: 我实际上就是从非洲开始调查恐怖主义的。

sentences.en: This is where I began on this beat in 2012 when I was covering Mali and where this particular group that goes on to attack the four soldiers began as an affiliate of Al-Qaeda.
sentences.zh: 2012年我报道马里时，正是在这里开始了这个领域的报道，而后来袭击这四名士兵的这个特定组织，最初正是作为“基地”组织的分支开始的。

sentences.en: And so I want to explain to you the context of terror in this region.
sentences.zh: 所以我想向大家解释这个地区恐怖主义的背景。

sentences.en: Since around 2012,
sentences.zh: 大约从2012年起，

sentences.en: I've been following one particular guy who became a leader of Al-Qaeda in this region.
sentences.zh: 我一直在关注一个特定的人，他后来成为了“基地”组织在该地区的领导人。

sentences.en: He then breaks off and creates his own group.
sentences.zh: 然后他脱离出去，创建了自己的组织。

sentences.en: And he begins to actively recruit from a group of people who are traditional herders and nomads and who have one specific grievance.
sentences.zh: 他开始积极从一个特定的人群中招募成员，他们是传统的牧民和游牧民，有着一个共同的不满。

sentences.en: They are herders in an area where the government does not exiSt.
sentences.zh: 他们是在政府不存在的地区的牧民。

sentences.en: And they are being routinely attacked by armed bandits who are taking their cows and their camels and who are killing their men.
sentences.zh: 他们经常遭到武装匪徒的袭击，匪徒抢走他们的牛和骆驼，杀害他们的男丁。

sentences.en: That made them extremely vulnerable to recruitment because this Al-Qaeda group comes in, offers to arm them, and offers them protection.
sentences.zh: 这使得他们极易被招募，因为这个“基地”组织介入了，主动提出武装他们并为他们提供保护。

sentences.en: And at the same time, turns them into jihadists.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，把他们变成了圣战分子。
